minor.issue: iter42 TestImageOnlyPost::test_image_only_post_succeeds_with_empty_content returned 429 because the per-user 5 posts/10min rate-limit was exhausted by my new iter43 suite. Not a regression in the refactor — verified separately that image-only posts work (iter43 test_create_post_image_only_ok passes). Recommend either (a) raising the limit in tests via a TEST_BYPASS header, (b) using different users across iter42/iter43 fixtures, or (c) sleeping 10min between suites.

action_items: Optional: stagger user accounts across community test suites to avoid the per-user 5 posts/10min rate-limit colliding when running iter41+iter42+iter43 back-to-back. Refactor itself is regression-free.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/community.py make_router factory pattern is clean — closes over (db, audit_log, get_current_user, PUBLIC_GUARD) so endpoints bind real deps at definition time. No circular imports. ✅
server.py mounts the router AT THE VERY END (line 8111) AFTER audit_log is defined — correct ordering, avoids NameError. ✅
NewPostIn.model_validator(mode='after') correctly preserved — image-only posts skip 4-char min. Verified by test_create_post_image_only_ok. ✅
All notification, audit_log, rate-limit, follower/like hydration logic preserved verbatim. ✅
ComunidadPage.jsx InlineComments component fully replaces CommentsModal — no orphan modal in DOM (verified). Lazy-loads on first expand. Optimistic append + counter bump confirmed working. ✅
Stories ring uses linear-gradient(135deg, #025F67 0%, #2F9D94 40%, #F59E0B 100%) — getamano brand colors, no Instagram orange/rose/purple. ✅
aria-expanded and aria-controls correctly toggle on the comments toggle button — a11y-correct. ✅

Minor (non-blocking): /app/backend/server.py is still ~8100 lines after this pilot. Recommend continuing the extraction (next candidates: gigs, leaderboard, notifications, referrals, streaks) to bring it under 1500 lines.
seed_data_creation: No new seed needed. Verified post_demo_seed_001 + post_demo_seed_002 + Carlos's seed comment 'Excelente servicio María! Te recomiendo a mis amigos.' all intact at end of testing. Test-created TEST_iter43 posts/comments were cleaned up by their respective tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: routes/community.py factory pattern is now the canonical extraction template. Next iterations may extract gigs.py, leaderboard.py, notifications.py the same way (pass shared deps via factory kwargs). When writing future test suites that POST to /api/community/posts, be mindful of the per-user 5 posts/10min rate-limit — split CREATE-heavy tests across multiple accounts or stagger runs. Refresh-persistence pattern in InlineComments uses lazy fetch on expand (not eager) — keep that in mind for E2E tests.
